'''The Spyder''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] [[Pillaat and Nerro]] served as a bartender there.<ref name="UABS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref>
